warnings: B5B and B6/B6X are tapered (height 'VARY') ramp-support beams — full height 600mm at the tall end, tapering down to 270-330mm at the ramp's low end over a short 0.65-0.80m transition zone, with the stirrup spacing tightening from 0.20m to 0.10m near the tapered end. Recorded with height_mm at the tall (typical) end and the tapered condition noted, since §0.5 has no field for a linearly-varying member depth.
